title: SBICAP Securities ties up with Appreciate to offer Indian investors access to 8,000+ global stocks
text: SBICAP Securities ties up with Appreciate to offer Indian investors access to 8,000+ global stocks. The partnership makes SBICAP Securities one of the few platforms in India to offer access through both GIFT City-based Global Access Providers, India INX GA, and NSEIXGA, under a single platform
